Our story

One van. One promise.

Rob Kalman arrived in the UK 14 years ago and started Rob’s Relocate with a single van and a simple promise: treat every home as if it were his own.

Today he leads a team of professional movers trusted across Oxfordshire and the UK — from single-item collections to full family homes, every move gets the same care.

Robert Kalman Owner & Director, Robs Relocate Ltd
